table activities
  column created_at type=INTEGER notnull=0 default=strftime('%s', 'now') pk=0
  column distance_meters type=REAL notnull=0 default=<none> pk=0
  column duration_secs type=INTEGER notnull=0 default=<none> pk=0
  column id type=TEXT notnull=0 default=<none> pk=1
  column max_lat type=REAL notnull=1 default=<none> pk=0
  column max_lng type=REAL notnull=1 default=<none> pk=0
  column min_lat type=REAL notnull=1 default=<none> pk=0
  column min_lng type=REAL notnull=1 default=<none> pk=0
  column name type=TEXT notnull=0 default=<none> pk=0
  column sport_type type=TEXT notnull=1 default=<none> pk=0
  column start_date type=INTEGER notnull=0 default=<none> pk=0
  index idx_activities_bounds unique=0 origin=c partial=0 cols=[min_lat,max_lat,min_lng,max_lng]
  index idx_activities_sport unique=0 origin=c partial=0 cols=[sport_type]
  index auto(id) unique=1 origin=pk partial=0 cols=[id]
table activity_matches
  column activity_id type=TEXT notnull=1 default=<none> pk=2
  column direction type=TEXT notnull=1 default=<none> pk=0
  column match_percentage type=REAL notnull=1 default=<none> pk=0
  column route_id type=TEXT notnull=1 default=<none> pk=1
  index idx_activity_matches_route unique=0 origin=c partial=0 cols=[route_id]
  index auto(route_id,activity_id) unique=1 origin=pk partial=0 cols=[route_id,activity_id]
table activity_metrics
  column activity_id type=TEXT notnull=0 default=<none> pk=1
  column avg_hr type=INTEGER notnull=0 default=<none> pk=0
  column avg_power type=INTEGER notnull=0 default=<none> pk=0
  column date type=INTEGER notnull=1 default=<none> pk=0
  column distance type=REAL notnull=1 default=<none> pk=0
  column elapsed_time type=INTEGER notnull=1 default=<none> pk=0
  column elevation_gain type=REAL notnull=1 default=<none> pk=0
  column ftp type=INTEGER notnull=0 default=<none> pk=0
  column hr_zone_times type=TEXT notnull=0 default=<none> pk=0
  column moving_time type=INTEGER notnull=1 default=<none> pk=0
  column name type=TEXT notnull=1 default=<none> pk=0
  column power_zone_times type=TEXT notnull=0 default=<none> pk=0
  column sport_type type=TEXT notnull=1 default=<none> pk=0
  column training_load type=REAL notnull=0 default=<none> pk=0
  index auto(activity_id) unique=1 origin=pk partial=0 cols=[activity_id]
table athlete_profile
  column data type=TEXT notnull=1 default=<none> pk=0
  column id type=TEXT notnull=0 default='current' pk=1
  column updated_at type=INTEGER notnull=1 default=<none> pk=0
  index auto(id) unique=1 origin=pk partial=0 cols=[id]
table gps_tracks
  column activity_id type=TEXT notnull=0 default=<none> pk=1
  column point_count type=INTEGER notnull=1 default=<none> pk=0
  column track_data type=BLOB notnull=1 default=<none> pk=0
  index auto(activity_id) unique=1 origin=pk partial=0 cols=[activity_id]
  fk activity_id -> activities.id on_update=NO ACTION on_delete=CASCADE
table overlap_cache
  column activity_a type=TEXT notnull=1 default=<none> pk=1
  column activity_b type=TEXT notnull=1 default=<none> pk=2
  column computed_at type=INTEGER notnull=1 default=<none> pk=0
  column has_overlap type=INTEGER notnull=1 default=<none> pk=0
  column overlap_data type=BLOB notnull=0 default=<none> pk=0
  index idx_overlap_cache_a unique=0 origin=c partial=0 cols=[activity_a]
  index idx_overlap_cache_b unique=0 origin=c partial=0 cols=[activity_b]
  index auto(activity_a,activity_b) unique=1 origin=pk partial=0 cols=[activity_a,activity_b]
table processed_activities
  column activity_id type=TEXT notnull=0 default=<none> pk=1
  column processed_at type=TEXT notnull=1 default=datetime('now') pk=0
  index auto(activity_id) unique=1 origin=pk partial=0 cols=[activity_id]
table route_groups
  column activity_ids type=TEXT notnull=1 default=<none> pk=0
  column bounds_max_lat type=REAL notnull=0 default=<none> pk=0
  column bounds_max_lng type=REAL notnull=0 default=<none> pk=0
  column bounds_min_lat type=REAL notnull=0 default=<none> pk=0
  column bounds_min_lng type=REAL notnull=0 default=<none> pk=0
  column id type=TEXT notnull=0 default=<none> pk=1
  column representative_id type=TEXT notnull=1 default=<none> pk=0
  column sport_type type=TEXT notnull=1 default=<none> pk=0
  index idx_groups_sport unique=0 origin=c partial=0 cols=[sport_type]
  index auto(id) unique=1 origin=pk partial=0 cols=[id]
table route_names
  column custom_name type=TEXT notnull=1 default=<none> pk=0
  column route_id type=TEXT notnull=0 default=<none> pk=1
  index auto(route_id) unique=1 origin=pk partial=0 cols=[route_id]
table schema_info
  column key type=TEXT notnull=0 default=<none> pk=1
  column value type=TEXT notnull=1 default=<none> pk=0
  index auto(key) unique=1 origin=pk partial=0 cols=[key]
table section_activities
  column activity_id type=TEXT notnull=1 default=<none> pk=2
  column direction type=TEXT notnull=1 default='same' pk=0
  column distance_meters type=REAL notnull=1 default=0 pk=0
  column end_index type=INTEGER notnull=1 default=0 pk=0
  column lap_pace type=REAL notnull=0 default=<none> pk=0
  column lap_time type=REAL notnull=0 default=<none> pk=0
  column section_id type=TEXT notnull=1 default=<none> pk=1
  column start_index type=INTEGER notnull=1 default=0 pk=3
  index idx_section_activities_activity unique=0 origin=c partial=0 cols=[activity_id]
  index auto(section_id,activity_id,start_index) unique=1 origin=pk partial=0 cols=[section_id,activity_id,start_index]
  fk section_id -> sections.id on_update=NO ACTION on_delete=CASCADE
table sections
  column average_spread type=REAL notnull=0 default=<none> pk=0
  column confidence type=REAL notnull=0 default=<none> pk=0
  column created_at type=TEXT notnull=1 default=datetime('now') pk=0
  column distance_meters type=REAL notnull=1 default=<none> pk=0
  column end_index type=INTEGER notnull=0 default=<none> pk=0
  column id type=TEXT notnull=0 default=<none> pk=1
  column is_user_defined type=INTEGER notnull=0 default=0 pk=0
  column name type=TEXT notnull=0 default=<none> pk=0
  column observation_count type=INTEGER notnull=0 default=<none> pk=0
  column point_density_json type=TEXT notnull=0 default=<none> pk=0
  column polyline_json type=TEXT notnull=1 default=<none> pk=0
  column representative_activity_id type=TEXT notnull=0 default=<none> pk=0
  column scale type=TEXT notnull=0 default=<none> pk=0
  column section_type type=TEXT notnull=1 default=<none> pk=0
  column source_activity_id type=TEXT notnull=0 default=<none> pk=0
  column sport_type type=TEXT notnull=1 default=<none> pk=0
  column stability type=REAL notnull=0 default=<none> pk=0
  column start_index type=INTEGER notnull=0 default=<none> pk=0
  column updated_at type=TEXT notnull=0 default=<none> pk=0
  column version type=INTEGER notnull=0 default=1 pk=0
  index idx_sections_sport unique=0 origin=c partial=0 cols=[sport_type]
  index idx_sections_type unique=0 origin=c partial=0 cols=[section_type]
  index auto(id) unique=1 origin=pk partial=0 cols=[id]
table signatures
  column activity_id type=TEXT notnull=0 default=<none> pk=1
  column end_point_lat type=REAL notnull=1 default=<none> pk=0
  column end_point_lng type=REAL notnull=1 default=<none> pk=0
  column point_count type=INTEGER notnull=1 default=<none> pk=0
  column points type=BLOB notnull=1 default=<none> pk=0
  column start_point_lat type=REAL notnull=1 default=<none> pk=0
  column start_point_lng type=REAL notnull=1 default=<none> pk=0
  column total_distance type=REAL notnull=1 default=<none> pk=0
  index auto(activity_id) unique=1 origin=pk partial=0 cols=[activity_id]
  fk activity_id -> activities.id on_update=NO ACTION on_delete=CASCADE
table sport_settings
  column data type=TEXT notnull=1 default=<none> pk=0
  column id type=TEXT notnull=0 default='current' pk=1
  column updated_at type=INTEGER notnull=1 default=<none> pk=0
  index auto(id) unique=1 origin=pk partial=0 cols=[id]
table time_streams
  column activity_id type=TEXT notnull=0 default=<none> pk=1
  column point_count type=INTEGER notnull=1 default=<none> pk=0
  column times type=BLOB notnull=1 default=<none> pk=0
  index auto(activity_id) unique=1 origin=pk partial=0 cols=[activity_id]
  fk activity_id -> activities.id on_update=NO ACTION on_delete=CASCADE
index idx_activities_bounds :: CREATE INDEX idx_activities_bounds ON activities(min_lat, max_lat, min_lng, max_lng)
index idx_activities_sport :: CREATE INDEX idx_activities_sport ON activities(sport_type)
index idx_activity_matches_route :: CREATE INDEX idx_activity_matches_route ON activity_matches(route_id)
index idx_groups_sport :: CREATE INDEX idx_groups_sport ON route_groups(sport_type)
index idx_overlap_cache_a :: CREATE INDEX idx_overlap_cache_a ON overlap_cache(activity_a)
index idx_overlap_cache_b :: CREATE INDEX idx_overlap_cache_b ON overlap_cache(activity_b)
index idx_section_activities_activity :: CREATE INDEX idx_section_activities_activity ON section_activities(activity_id)
index idx_sections_sport :: CREATE INDEX idx_sections_sport ON sections(sport_type)
index idx_sections_type :: CREATE INDEX idx_sections_type ON sections(section_type)
